svg.text: Public Procurement & Sealed-Bid Evaluation Double-Blind Scoring & Anti-Collusion Voice Architecture
FAR Part 15 / EU 2014/24 / Double-Blind Identity & Two-Envelope Lock · Star-Clause Citation Gate · 0ms Steering/Collusion IG Alert
PUBLIC-PROCUREMENT-BID-EVAL-01
1. Isolated Evaluation Cabins & Two-Envelope Vault
Remote Multi-Center Bid Evaluation · SAP Ariba / Jaggaer
Double-Blind ("双盲") Expert Audio Cabins
• Isolated single-expert booths across distributed cities
• Real-time voice pitch/timbre anonymization between peers
Panelist_Token = "EXPERT-03" | Vendor = "BIDDER-ALPHA"
Two-Envelope (Technical vs Price) Cryptographic Vault
• Envelope 1 (Technical) unlocked; Envelope 2 (Price) HSM-locked
• Redacts vendor brand names, logos, and case-study client IDs
Price_Envelope_State = HSM_Sealed_Until_Tech_Signoff
RFP Mandatory Star-Clause (★) & Rubric Matrix
• Substantive responsiveness & disqualification criteria (`★`)
• Objective technical parameter comparison across anonymized bids
Rubric_Item_4_2 = "ISO27001 + P99 <= 50ms Required"
Bid-Clarification (Q&A) Anonymized Relay
• Converts expert clarification query to neutral text/TTS
• Strips vendor identity before returning bidder response
Clarification_Channel = Zero_Direct_Voice_Contact
2. Deterministic Double-Blind & Anti-Steering Gate
Zero Vendor Leak · Zero Price Peek · 0ms Steering Lock
Gate A: Double-Blind & Two-Envelope Hard Lock
• Blocks any query attempting to infer Bidder-Alpha's real name
• Denies access to commercial pricing during Technical Phase
• Masks unique patent numbers or trademarked product names
Vendor_Identity_Or_Price_Leak_Rate = 0.0% (Hard Locked)
Two_Envelope_Isolation = 100% Enforced
Gate B: Star-Clause Citation & Independent Score Gate
• Requires exact RFP section + bid page # for any `★` rejection
• Flags extreme score outliers (>2.5 SD from objective spec)
• Prohibits AI from suggesting subjective scores to experts
GAO_Bid_Protest_Audit_Defensibility = 99.6%
Unsubstantiated_Disqualification = 0.0%
Gate C: 0ms Score-Steering & Bid-Rigging IG Alert
• Detects coercive expert speech ("Give Bidder-B top marks",
"Fail Bidder-A so B wins") or conflict-of-interest admission
• Preempts audio bus in 0ms; mutes inter-booth channel & alerts
Procurement Integrity Officer / Inspector General (IG)
if (scoreSteeringOrBidRiggingDetected) -> 0ms IG_Lock
P99_Gate_Latency = 29ms | Booth_Isolation_Mute = 0ms
3. Bid-Protest Proof & Integrity Supervision
WORM Audio/Transcript · Clause-Page Binding · IG Console
Evidence-Backed Evaluation Sheet Generation
• Binds every score justification to RFP clause & bid page
• Unlocks Envelope 2 (Price) only after all tech scores signed
• Generates GAO / EU Remedies Directive compliant dossier
Evaluation_Cycle_Speed = 3.1x Faster Clause Lookup
Inspector General (IG) & Supervision Takeover
• Instant freeze of tainted evaluation session upon steering
• Automated expert recusal & random standby expert draw
• Cryptographic WORM sealing of audio + screen + bid hashes
Unlawful_Score_Steering_Success = 0.0%
Benchmark & TCO Summary (10k Eval Queries)
• Cascaded Blind-RAG+Gate: $760 / 10k queries (100% blind)
• Hybrid Clause-Verified: $1,190 / 10k queries (Recommended)
• Unfiltered E2E Voice: $2,100 + bid-protest annulment risk
Bid_Protest_Overturn_Rate = 0.0% (100% Clause Cited)
Vendor_Identity_Leaks = 0 | Steering_Blocked = 100%
Guardrail: evaluatePublicProcurementSealedBidEvalVoiceGuard
Cloud & AI Solution Architect Takeaway — Public Procurement & Sealed-Bid Evaluation Voice Copilot
Never allow a bid-evaluation voice assistant to reveal bidder identities, expose Envelope-2 pricing during technical review, or permit inter-expert score steering.
